title: Photosynthesis
emblem: a green leaf with a sunlit vein

chapters.title: What Limits It?
chapters.narration: Chapter four. कौन-सी कमी photosynthesis को धीमा कर सकती है?

beats.say: अब सोचो, greenhouse में पौधे को भरपूर पानी और अच्छी रोशनी मिले, लेकिन carbon dioxide कम हो।

do.generate: A lush tomato plant inside a glass greenhouse, sunbeams slanting through the panes, irrigation droplets at the roots, a few sparse carbon-dioxide particles drifting toward the leaves; detailed botanical illustration with shaded shapes, bright highlights and fine engraved rims, against a dark navy atmosphere, no text

do.text: Will photosynthesis run just as fast?

beats.say: नहीं, कमी वाला factor पूरी process को limit कर देगा।
Photosynthesis की rate तीन चीज़ों पर depend करती है: light intensity, carbon dioxide concentration और temperature।
इनमें से कोई एक भी कम पड़े, तो बाकी दोनों भरपूर होने पर भी rate को वही रोकता है।

do.code:
greenhouse = image("tomato_greenhouse", height=3.75)
greenhouse.move_to([3.75, -0.05, 0])

co2_title = Text("CO₂ IN THE GREENHOUSE", font_size=28, color=INK)
co2_title.move_to([-4.05, 2.25, 0])

base_y = -1.25
bar_w = 0.82
ambient_x = -5.15
greenhouse_x = -3.25
max_h = 2.55
ambient_h = 1.07
raised_h = 2.55

ambient_frame = Rectangle(width=bar_w, height=max_h, stroke_color=MUTED_INK, stroke_width=2, fill_opacity=0)
ambient_frame.move_to([ambient_x, base_y + max_h/2, 0])
raised_frame = Rectangle(width=bar_w, height=max_h, stroke_color=MUTED_INK, stroke_width=2, fill_opacity=0)
raised_frame.move_to([greenhouse_x, base_y + max_h/2, 0])

ambient_fill = Rectangle(width=bar_w-0.10, height=ambient_h, stroke_width=0, fill_color=PALETTE["GOLD"], fill_opacity=0.95)
ambient_fill.move_to([ambient_x, base_y + ambient_h/2, 0])
low_fill = Rectangle(width=bar_w-0.10, height=0.65, stroke_width=0, fill_color=PALETTE["GOLD"], fill_opacity=0.95)
low_fill.move_to([greenhouse_x, base_y + 0.325, 0])
full_fill = Rectangle(width=bar_w-0.10, height=raised_h, stroke_width=0, fill_color=PALETTE["GOLD"], fill_opacity=0.95)
full_fill.move_to([greenhouse_x, base_y + raised_h/2, 0])

ambient_label = Text("Ambient air", font_size=23, color=INK)
ambient_label.move_to([ambient_x, 1.65, 0])
greenhouse_label = Text("Greenhouse", font_size=23, color=INK)
greenhouse_label.move_to([greenhouse_x, 1.65, 0])
ambient_value = Text("≈420 ppm", font_size=23, color=MUTED_INK)
ambient_value.move_to([ambient_x, -1.78, 0])
raised_value = Text("≈1000 ppm", font_size=25, color=PALETTE["GOLD"])
raised_value.move_to([greenhouse_x, -1.78, 0])
ratio_note = Text("More than 2× ambient air", font_size=25, color=INK)
ratio_note.move_to([-4.15, -2.35, 0])

faster_note = Text("Tomatoes grow faster", font_size=25, color=INK)
faster_note.move_to([3.75, -2.25, 0])
growth_arrow = Arrow(start=[1.55, -1.25, 0], end=[1.55, 0.15, 0], color=PALETTE["GREEN"], stroke_width=5, buff=0)

self.play(FadeIn(greenhouse), Write(co2_title), run_time=1.0)
self.play(FadeIn(ambient_frame), FadeIn(raised_frame), FadeIn(ambient_fill), Write(ambient_label), Write(greenhouse_label), run_time=0.9)
self.play(Write(ambient_value), FadeIn(low_fill), run_time=0.7)
self.play(ReplacementTransform(low_fill, full_fill), Write(raised_value), run_time=1.0)
self.play(Write(ratio_note), GrowArrow(growth_arrow), Write(faster_note), run_time=0.9)
self.wait(0.4)
do.plan: On a clean dark board, draw three parallel horizontal factor sliders labelled Light, CO₂, and Temperature, each initially high in gold. As the spoken line describes a factor being low, animate any one slider (cycle through the three as a visual 'whichever one') dropping to a short sand-colored level while the other two stay high. Beneath them draw a shared photosynthesis-rate output bar; its fill falls to match the shortest slider, with a clear connector from the short slider to the output. Keep labels large and readable; use the newsroom palette and shaded rimmed shapes. Do not assign numerical values.

beats.say: इसीलिए greenhouse में farmers carbon dioxide को करीब 1000 parts per million तक बढ़ाते हैं।
यह हवा के level से दोगुने से भी ज़्यादा है, और इससे tomatoes तेज़ी से बढ़ते हैं।
